static_traits.name: 泰勒
static_traits.occupation: University student（大学棒球Athlete，首发游击手）
static_traits.educational_background: 正在攻读体育管理Bachelor's degree
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and younger sister
static_traits.social_status: 拥有支持性的队友与朋友，但因Self-doubt难以向他人敞开；与队友关系出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, can describe concrete situations; thinking shows repetitive overthinking and negative tendencies; tone is pessimistic and tense; cooperativeness is high but hesitates about exposing vulnerability

basic_info.main_problem: 自从上周比赛错过一个关键回合后，一直觉得自己not是一个好球员，持续过度思考并害怕再犯错，影响练习与比赛表现，同时睡眠与Academics affected。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望停止Persistent self-doubt，重建自信，重新享受棒球与生活，并改善比赛中的表现。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough（能力not足）
我not配做首发/I am a failure

special_situations.event: In last week's game, missed a key play (as the starting shortstop)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果关键时刻出现一次失误，就证明我整体not够好，not配当首发
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在训练中对每个动作过度思考、强行Repression负面念头，并通过观看励志视频试图提升信心
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not是一个好球员，我以后也会一直犯错

special_situations.event: 在训练或比赛中再次出现与上次相似的高压情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我再犯错，队友会看轻我、关系会恶化
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 高度警惕、避免冒险动作，尽量not表达真实感受
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都在看着我，等我出错

special_situations.event: 比赛或训练中完成了正确的动作或好的表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非每一次都完美，否则说明我仍然not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视正面反馈，继续Self-doubt和反刍错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次做对也not算什么，我最终还是会搞砸

special_situations.event: 夜间睡前回想比赛与训练，担心not yet来再次失误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有提前not断担心和推演，才能避免下一次错误
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复脑演情境、not断自我检查，迟迟without法放松入睡
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很可能会再犯错，后果会很糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable, reliable player, maintaining confidence and stable performance
core_conflict.fear: Fears being looked down on by teammates/others after making mistakes, being labeled a 'loser', losing position and value
defense_goal: 通过Repression情绪与过度控制来避免暴露脆弱与错误
维持表面的镇定以减少他人负面评价

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、随时准备批评自己的他人（队友/观众）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked to recall and describe in detail that mistake, or being watched during a competition
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to interpret others' attention as criticism or as waiting for them to make a mistake (transference)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Restrained, brief tone, emphasizing 'I will focus on the match', avoiding touching on feelings of shame and fear

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询师探问其情绪体验与脆弱时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that exposing vulnerability will lead to being belittled, therefore tends to shift to factual and technical discussions
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tends to discuss tactical arrangements and training plans in a relatively objective, rational tone, reducing emotional vocabulary

manifestations: 难以向支持性的队友与朋友敞开表达not安与失败感
在高压比赛情境中感到被注视与评判

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: 把错误放大并持续反刍
担心“not配”和队友交流而选择闭合

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others
manifestations: 认为队友都在等自己出错
将他人目光解释为对自己的轻视或批评

contact_model.definition: 个体将原欲对外发出的能量转而对自己，或放弃向外寻求do not人为其做某事
manifestations: not愿向支持者求助、难以开口表达情绪
把压力与羞耻向内消化、自我消耗

positive_force: 拥有支持性的队友与朋友
主动寻求咨询与改变的意愿
具备首发游击手的竞skill力基础（此前能够胜任）
negative_force: 过度思维与反刍，倾向灾难化与negate正面
对错误的强烈恐惧与对外部评价过度敏感
难以向他人敞开求助导致自我孤立
Sleep disturbed与Decreased attention，进一步影响学业与比赛表现

target_behavior.behavior: In training and games, worries excessively about making mistakes and overthinks every play
antecedent: 出现与上次失误相似的高压或关键情境
与队友共同练习/比赛时被关注
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失误过度概括为能力not足，把自我价值与完美表现绑定，并担心被队友看轻
target_behavior.function: 试图避免潜在错误、维持控制与Self-protection（避免他人负面评价）
target_behavior.consequence: 表现僵硬与信心下降，团队Relationship tension，进一步ReinforcementSelf-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep disturbed（入睡困难、辗转反侧）
antecedent: 临睡前回想比赛与训练
target_behavior.core_reason: 为避免再次失误而进行持续的担忧与脑演，预测not yet来负面结果
target_behavior.function: 通过反刍与担忧来寻求安全感与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Declining sleep quality、Academics affected、次日竞技状态变差
